| notes = '''Offers Directions Around Town:'''
:Hiya! Are you lost or something? If you're in trouble, Anja-Enja's here to helpy-welpy!
:*"''Nothing right now.''": Well, if you ever need help, feel free to ask one of us guards. Helping out people in need is the calling of us guards in Windurst Waters's "North Winds" troupey-woupey.
:*"''Where are we?''": This is the Windurst Waters district. Just north of here are the Opistery, the Aurastery, and a general goods store. South of here are the Rhinostery and the hatter's.
:*"''How to leave town.''": The quickest way to leave town from here is Odin's Gate, which takes you out to West Sarutabaruta. Head north and pass through the archway of the Opistery's Library of Magic. Then go over the bridge until you get to the northern gatehouse. (That's where we guards of Windurst Waters meet, you know?) Head through the gate and you'll find yourself outside in West Sarutabaruta.
:*"''Where's the residential area?''": Windurst's residential area is northeast of here. To get there, first head north and cross the bridge to the east that leads to the Aurastery and Windurst Walls. On the way, you'll come across a Cardian automaton guard. Turn right when you see him and you'll easily find your way there.
| historicalbackground = 
}}

Please see the entry items (below) for more details. | historicalbackground = }} ==Entry Items== === One of Three === If you possess one of the following three crest [[Key Item|key items]] and the required rock, the Anomaly Expert will synthesize the corresponding [[Yantric planchette]] [[Key Item|key items]] for entry to the specific [[Delve]].
If you don't meet these conditions, she will ignore your attempt to trade the rock. *{{KeyItem}} [[Aged Matriarch Naakual crest]] *{{KeyItem}} [[Aged Firebrand Naakual crest]] *{{KeyItem}} [[Aged Riptide Naakual crest]] The rock, corresponding [[Key Item]], and [[Delve]] are: *[[Celadon Yggrete]] **[[Key Item]]: {{KeyItem}} [[Celadon yantric planchette]] **[[Delve]] (NM): [[Ceizak Battlegrounds]] ([[Colkhab]]) *[[Zaffre Yggrete]] **[[Key Item]]: {{KeyItem}} [[Zaffre yantric planchette]] **[[Delve]] (NM): [[Foret de Hennetiel]] ([[Tchakka]]) *[[Alizarin Yggrete]] **[[Key Item]]: {{KeyItem}} [[Alizarin yantric planchette]] **[[Delve]] (NM): [[Morimar Basalt Fields]] ([[Achuka]]) === Specific [[Naakual|Naakual Crests]] === The Anomaly Expert requires you possess the [[Naakual|Naakual Crests]] obtained by beating the three lower [[Delve]], and the required rock, before she will synthesize the corresponding [[Key Item|key item]] for entry to the specific [[Delve]].
If you don't meet these conditions, she will ignore your attempt to trade the rock. *{{KeyItem}} [[Aged Booming Naakual crest]] **Rock: [[Phlox Yggrete]] ***[[Key Item]]: {{KeyItem}} [[Phlox yantric planchette]] ***[[Delve]] (NM): [[Marjami Ravine]] ([[Hurkan]]) *{{KeyItem}} [[Aged Ligneous Naakual crest]] **Rock: [[Russet Yggrete]] ***[[Key Item]]: {{KeyItem}} [[Russet yantric planchette]] ***[[Delve]] (NM): [[Yorcia Weald]] ([[Yumcax]]) *{{KeyItem}} [[Aged Flashfrost Naakual crest]] **Rock: [[Aster Yggrete]] ***[[Key Item]]: {{KeyItem}} [[Aster yantric planchette]] ***[[Delve]] (NM): [[Kamihr Drifts]] ([[Kumhau]]) ==Other Services== *Corresponding Yggzi bead items (e.g. [[Alizarin Yggzi I]]) can be subsequently traded to the Anomaly Expert for implementation with the planchette. This removes the corresponding Delve NM from the Fracture area upon entry. Yggzi beads can also be removed and returned to inventory one at a time with the planchette defusion option. *After obtaining all three [[Delve]] mega boss key items ({{KeyItem}} [[Craggy fin]], {{KeyItem}} [[Flame-scarred skull]], {{KeyItem}} [[Detached stinger]]), the Anomaly Expert allows you to expend all three for one piece of boss equipment, an [[Airlixir +1]], or an [[Airlixir +2]] at random. Obtaining all three again allows you to repeat the process. After clearing a boss once, boss items can still be purchased from [[Forri-Porri]] for [[Mweya Plasm Corpuscles|plasm]] even after expending the key items through this process. [[Category:Delve]]
